programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programs.feeNote: PUMBA admission instructions AY 2026-27 list fees (first-year admission, per category): OPEN Rs 1,63,983; OBC/EWS/SEBC Rs 88,358; SC/ST Rs 11,953; SBC/VJ-DT/NT-B/C/D Rs 12,733; OMS Rs 1,64,483; CIWGC/ICCR SAARC Rs 3,15,733; foreign national/PIO/OCI Rs 4,66,983. Full 2-year total not published, so feeTotal left null.
programs.intakeNote: Seat count not found on an accessible official page (CAP seat matrix on the CET Cell portal not retrieved).
programs.placementNote: Latest official PUMBA placement report found (version dated 14 Oct 2024, batch 2022-24): 171 participants, 80.7% placed, 140+ companies; highest Rs 16.22 LPA, top-10% avg Rs 15.42 LPA, top-50% avg Rs 10.84 LPA, average Rs 9.40 LPA. An earlier 28 Sep 2024 version of the same report shows different figures (highest Rs 19 LPA). Median not published. No 2023-25 or 2024-26 report found.

selectionProcess.name: Maharashtra State CAP (Centralised Admission Process)
selectionProcess.detail: Seats allotted by State CET Cell, Maharashtra on CAP merit (MAH-MBA/MMS-CET or other accepted national test scores) over CAP Rounds I-IV; candidates confirm admission at PUMBA with documents and fees.

selectionProcess.name: Institute-level round (post-CAP vacancies)
selectionProcess.detail: Vacant seats after CAP filled through an institute-level round per CET Cell rules.
